import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**Verdict:** Yes, add `[[` completion in free-form prompts. Native Obsidian already does this in markdown editors; Bob’s plugin prompts are HTML `<input>`/`<textarea>`, so `EditorSuggest` never fires. Intention YAML already stores and renders `[[links]]`. Mac Capture already has first-class `[[` completion. The gap is the plugin prompt layer.

**Requirement adjustments (called out in the report):**
1. Not every text field — only Markdown-prose fields that write vault text (intentions, work log, schedule/rotten/cancel reasons, record text). Skip identifiers, search, command mode, bank keys, relation labels.
2. Do not spawn `bob capture-complete` per keystroke in plugins (disk index ~300 ms, misses unsaved buffers, capture-grammar coupling).
3. No Create-note row in v1.
4. Defer `((` task wikilinks.
5. While the menu is open: Enter/Tab insert (do not submit the host); Esc closes the menu first; Ctrl+N/P navigate; `q` still types.
6. Empty `[[` prefers workspace recents, then living notes.
7. Include headings/blocks/aliases/`![[` and Bob extras `[[##`/`[[^^``; keep row chrome aligned with Mac Capture.
8. Fail-open on mobile/missing cache.
9. Upgrade the record-card link stage to the same engine (`mode: "field"`).

**Recommended solution:** a shared `wikiLink.attach` sibling of Log Recall on bob-navigation-hotkeys. Catalog from Obsidian `metadataCache` (instant, includes unsaved notes, same resolver as clicks). Ranking ported from `capture_links` `MatchKind`. Compact popover (5–8 rows) in property-card/log-recall chrome with Mac Capture row anatomy. Hide/dim the Log Recall band while `[[` is active. Selection by key (path+kind+id), not index.

Ship order: intention editor and work summary first, then lane/release, schedule/rotten/cancel, record text/list, then record link-kind.

Rejected: per-keystroke bob, `AbstractInputSuggest` as the primary UI, and embedding CodeMirror so native `EditorSuggest` fires.
